dialogue.subject: urban
dialogue.text: A gun this size does not defend a wall. It changes the mind of the man approaching it.

dialogue.subject: loukas
dialogue.text: It changes the mind of the treasurer first.

dialogue.subject: urban
dialogue.text: Bronze. Powder. Charcoal. Masons. Carpenters. Oxen. A foundry that can breathe without collapsing. And pay enough that my men do not sell the design before the mold dries.
